messages:
alex: hey team — i'm alex (starting today on infra). quick q: where should i post setup issues vs product questions? any slack etiquette i should follow? thanks!

lina: welcome alex :tada: — short cheat: post laptop/network/account stuff in #help (or DM @it-help). onboarding/admin questions go here in #new-hires so ppl can help. product questions -> #product. infra/devops stuff -> #eng-infra.

sam: a few quick norms: 1) always reply in thread (keeps channels readable). 2) use emoji reactions for simple acknowledgements (:thumbsup:). 3) avoid @channel/@here unless you're coordinating people for an incident or blocking work. 4) paste long logs to a gist/drive link, not raw in-channel.

raj: eng note — if it's a deploy or runtime issue, post in #eng-releases or #eng-runtime and include these fields: service, region, brief symptom, last deploy. Example template: `service: auth-svc
region: us-west-2
symptom: increased latency after deploy` Also tag @oncall if it's P1.

onboarding-bot: Hi Alex! Run `onboard start` in DM with me to claim your checklists. You can also use `/onboard status` to show outstanding items.

alex: thanks all — super helpful. one follow-up: where do i ask about which bots do what?

lina: good q — we have a pinned list in this channel (see pins) but quick list: @onboarding-bot = new hire checklist, @deploy-bot = triggers deploys (eng-releases only), @pagerduty-bot = incident paging, @it-help = account/device requests. if unsure, ask here or DM me.

sam: etiquette extras: 1) anonymize logs (no secrets/API keys). 2) use threads for follow-ups. 3) mark messages needing attention with :eyes: or explicitly mention someone. 4) if you need async help, leave a one-line summary at top of thread so folks can triage.

alex: noted — will run `onboard start` now. thanks everyone! :smile:

lina: welcome again — ping any of us if you get stuck. i'll DM you the internal onboarding doc and a map of common channels.

raj: also — if you're joining oncall rotation, sam will add you to the roster and give a 30-min walkthrough.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: complete profile and 2FA step to unlock certain channels.

sam: TL;DR: channels = #help for setup, #new-hires for onboarding q's, #product for feature q's, #eng-* for engineering ops. Threads + reactions > flooding channels.

alex: got it, thanks all!
